scope: Factory/requests, scientific stateful methods, provenance/Lab boundaries, MAPIE and v1 migration; reviewed current files while integration owner was updating evidence.

findings.title: Migration silently redirects an earlier operation when a later operation is named default
findings.observed: status=translated, issues=[]; bindings.default.command becomes [/predict], and capabilities.fit has no using override. fit consequently resolves to /predict. Both original operations are valid v1 IDs and distinct executable paths.
findings.impact: A trusted migration can call a different scientific or production operation while retaining the earlier action description.
findings.general_fix: Allocate collision-free binding names independently of operation IDs and explicitly set every capability using value. Normalize and verify translated dispatch equivalence before reporting translated.

findings.title: Prediction metadata falsely claims 90 percent confidence for a valid 50 percent model
findings.attempt: Fit a trusted upstream MAPIE SplitConformalRegressor(confidence_level=0.5), serialize it, Host.put_artifact, then Host.call(release,predict_intervals,{model:ref,data:{x:five_points}}).
findings.observed: Call succeeded/complete and produced calibrated intervals from that 50 percent model with confidence_level:0.9. The model digest was correctly verified; byte integrity does not prove model compatibility.
findings.impact: A valid external or historical model artifact can yield scientifically incorrect confidence metadata without any diagnostic.
findings.general_fix: Validate model type and calibration state; derive the confidence level from the loaded model or reject incompatible configuration. Persist model metadata containing method/version/configuration/dependency producer lineage and validate it against the expected interface.

findings.title: Evaluation silently broadcasts malformed bounds and accepts inverted intervals
findings.attempt: Evaluate digest-verified JSON {lower:[0,0],upper:[[1],[10]]} with labels [5,5]; separately {lower:[10,20],upper:[0,1]} with labels [5,15].
findings.observed: First returns succeeded/complete with coverage=0.5, width=5.5,count=2 despite a 2x2 comparison. Second returns succeeded/complete with mean_width=-14.5. Only labels.shape==lower.shape is checked.
findings.impact: Malformed artifact data yields plausible numerical research outputs; a successful runtime receipt obscures the malformed evaluation subject.
findings.general_fix: Require nonempty finite 1D lower,upper,labels arrays of equal shape and enforce lower<=upper before computing per-sample metrics. Invalid scientific input should return a clear tool error; valid poor coverage should continue to execute successfully.

findings.title: Sealing publishes a release with a missing bundle-relative entry script
findings.attempt: Native binding command=[{python},{bundle}/absent.py] in a package containing cc.yaml only; Host.seal then Host.call(run,{}).
findings.observed: Seal returns a release digest. Call dispatches Python then fails PROCESS_FAILED because absent.py does not exist.
findings.impact: Factory can label a missing-source package sealed even when its explicit bundled entrypoint is unresolved; consumers learn this only after dispatch.
findings.general_fix: At minimum check explicit bundle-relative command material exists and is captured during seal. Preserve distinction between source-complete seal and separately qualified runtime/dependencies; do not imply sealing proves code semantics.

findings.title: Migration reports translated before validating source or destination declarations
findings.attempt: migrate_v1 with cc=1, valid action and ports but carrier=repo:latest, then normalize returned declaration.
findings.observed: Migration reports translated with issues=[], while normalize immediately rejects returned declaration as MUTABLE_BINDING.
findings.impact: Migration status is unreliable for unsupported/malformed source bindings and can be mistaken for a completed admissible translation.
findings.general_fix: Validate the v1 input and normalize the candidate before translated; turn any unsupported semantics or destination validation failures into explicit needs_review issues without a completed declaration.

verified_boundaries.case: Fixed request requirements and methodological mismatch
verified_boundaries.attempt: Resolve fixed does=Use paper method A, no substitutes with an open binding answered by Python -c print(42).
verified_boundaries.observed: Resolver preserves fixed text and accepts a structurally valid binding; it cannot prove implementation semantics. This matches documented generic resolver limits. Scientific acceptance requires evidence/checker/review outside pointer filling.

verified_boundaries.observed: UNKNOWN_FIELD. Generic v2 runtime has no built-in architecture ABI/driver/model qualification schema; require declared unsupported semantics to be represented through a registered supported policy or treat qualification as external and pending. MAPIE package contains cc.yaml and method.py only; package has no dependency lock reference. Current integration README and requirements-tested.lock provide pinned demonstrated environment separately, including sklearn1.5.2,numpy2.2.6 and exact MAPIE source revision. README honestly records reduced dependency environment/pip-check failure. Package-local reproduction instructions should point directly to these files; requirements.txt alone covers host not MAPIE.

verified_boundaries.case: Pickle trust is separate from checksums
verified_boundaries.observed: Host validates bytes and can accept arbitrary caller-staged local artifact references; it does not authenticate model producer or prove pickle safety. method.py pickle.load executes trusted serialized material. Current 05 documentation explicitly warns to admit only trusted producers, so no missing-warning finding raised. The method comment claiming release-store digest should not be treated as producer admission.

03 explicitly separates succeeded/partial, unknown effects and assessment. 04/11 require exact loaded binary/configuration/generation/window, pinned models/workload and independent frozen criteria. Current evidence does not establish full paper, deployed agent end-to-end, container execution or qualified-host Strata/Muse/GB10 reproduction.
